rūna , ae,f.,
I.a kind of weapon, a javelin or dart.
I. Lit.: “runa genus teli significat. Ennius: runata recedit, id est pilata,” Fest. p. 263 Müll.: “C. Gracchus runis et iis sicis, quas, etc.... nonne omnem rei publicae statum permutavit?” Cic. Leg. 3, 9, 20 Mos. N. cr.—
II. Transf., the runic written character, runes: barbara fraxineis pingatur runa tabellis, Ven. Carm. 7, 18, 19.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
